caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a fire station with a steam-powered fire engine and firefighting equipment. Dominating the foreground is a large, metallic, silver steam fire engine with complex pipes, gauges, and wheels, the wheels being red with black spokes and gold accents. Directly behind and attached to it is a red wooden fire wagon labeled “H.L. CO. No 1,” featuring gold decorations and black seats, equipped with a hose reel containing black hoses. A brass bell hangs above the steam engine. The floor is made of large, gray tiles, with coiled fire hoses, black boots, and a helmet lying on it. In the right corner, there is a wooden crate marked “F.D. Squad No. 1,” a glass lantern, and a black fire helmet. The station walls are tan and tiled, with a clock mounted in the center and a plaque visible on the left. The ceiling and upper wall trims are made of wood. Two vertical brass poles reach from the floor to the ceiling. At the back, large green double doors, windows with gridded panes, and an opening framed with red, white, and blue bunting that shows the exterior of a brick building and a sidewalk are present. A single telegraph or alarm box is mounted high on the left wall.
title: Fire Station
